_note: Categories of the one-off detail pool, v2 (placebo2). Same as v1 except two categories the item judge could not fill ('plant-free foods' contradicted the no-plant rule's wording; 'medical' items are rejected as medical): replaced by 'foods and pantry staples (no meat, fish, dairy, eggs or honey)' and 'personal care and toiletries'. Built with six letter-range calls per category (detail_pool_v2).
